ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET datos = EXCLUDED.datos, updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING org_id

INSERT INTO negocios (org_id, password, nombre, plan, demo_start, activo, email)
VALUES (
  $1,
  COALESCE($2, md5(random()::text)),
  $3,
  $4,
  NOW(),
  true,
  $5
)
ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET
  plan   = EXCLUDED.plan,
  activo = true,
  email  = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email, negocios.email)
RETURNING org_id, nombre, plan

INSERT INTO negocios (org_id, password, nombre, plan, demo_start)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET
  password = EXCLUDED.password,
  nombre = EXCLUDED.nombre,
  plan = EXCLUDED.plan,
  activo = true
RETURNING org_id, nombre, plan, demo_start
UPDATE negocios SET plan = $1, activo = true WHERE org_id = $2

SELECT org_id, nombre, plan, activo, demo_start, created_at
FROM negocios
ORDER BY created_at DESC
UPDATE negocios SET activo = false WHERE org_id = $1

INSERT INTO negocios (org_id, password, nombre, plan, demo_start, api_key, trial_end, last_activity, status, payment_status)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'trial', NOW(), $4, NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days', NOW(), 'active_trial', 'trial')
ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING org_id, nombre, plan, demo_start, api_key, trial_end

SELECT 
  org_id, nombre, plan, demo_start, activo, api_key,
  trial_end,
  payment_status,
  CASE 
    WHEN payment_status = 'paid' THEN false
    WHEN trial_end IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN trial_end < NOW() THEN true
    ELSE false
  END as trial_expired,
  CASE
    WHEN trial_end IS NOT NULL AND trial_end > NOW() AND payment_status != 'paid'
    THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM trial_end - NOW())::int
    ELSE NULL
  END as trial_days_left,
  true as found
FROM negocios
WHERE org_id = $1
AND password = $2
AND activo = true
LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO negocios (org_id, password, nombre, plan, demo_start, activo, email)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'trial', NOW(), true, $4)
ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING org_id, nombre, plan, demo_start
